discussions_and_forums.title: Fixture: best cheap eats in the city?
extensions: Locals say the fixture market lunch counters run about $12 a plate.

organic_results.title: Fixture: airport to downtown on a budget
organic_results.snippet: Skip the taxi ($99 quoted to us). The fixture airport bus is $2.75 and runs every 20 minutes.

organic_results.title: Fixture forum: money-saving thread
organic_results.snippet: Eat lunch at the fixture market; plates are about $12, half the dinner price downtown.

organic_results.title: Fixture blog: 15 ways to save
organic_results.snippet: Book hotels with free cancellation and recheck prices a week before; we saved on our stay.
